title: Satoshium Anchor Integrity Reference Base Schema
description: Base structural schema for a Satoshium Anchor Integrity Reference. This schema establishes the production object shape while intentionally leaving identifier syntax, Controlled Value enumerations, and method-specific policy unfrozen.

anchor_identifier.description: Stable Anchor-owned identifier for the Integrity Reference. Final syntax is governed by Identifier Architecture and is not frozen by this schema.

anchor_version.description: Governed Version number of this Integrity Reference representation. Versioning semantics are defined separately.

schema_version.description: Version of the Integrity Reference schema used to validate this record.

relationships.description: Machine-readable relationships associated with this Integrity Reference.

verification_history.description: Optional history of Integrity Verification outcomes. Final Verification record architecture remains separately governed.

corrections.description: Optional references to Anchor Corrections affecting this Integrity Reference.

notes.description: Optional governed human-readable context that does not replace structured fields.

source_institution.description: Institution authoritative for the Source Artifact.

source_artifact_type.description: Human- or machine-governed type of Source Artifact. Final Controlled Values remain unfrozen.

source_system_identifier.description: Identifier assigned by the Source Institution to the Source Artifact.

source_location.description: Canonical or authoritative Source location where applicable.

representation_type.description: Controlled representation category. Final enumeration remains unfrozen.

representation_boundary.description: Human-readable or governed statement defining what content is included in the anchored representation.

method.description: Canonicalization or serialization method used to create the Canonical Representation.

version.description: Version of the canonicalization method, where applicable.

parameters.description: Method-specific canonicalization parameters required for reproducibility.

canonical_representation_location.description: Location of the Canonical Representation where it is separately published or preserved.

media_type.description: Media type of the Canonical Representation where applicable.

encoding.description: Character or binary encoding where materially relevant.

methods.description: One or more integrity-generation methods applied to the Canonical Representation.

composite_order.description: Optional ordered method identifiers when sequence matters in a composite integrity process.

method_id.description: Record-local identifier for this integrity method instance.

method_type.description: Integrity Method Controlled Value. Enumeration remains unfrozen.

algorithm.description: Algorithm used by the method where applicable.

integrity_value.description: Generated Integrity Value where the method produces a directly stored value.

generated_at.description: Time the integrity material was generated, where applicable.

signer_reference.description: Signer or signing-role reference where applicable.

key_reference.description: Public key or certificate reference where applicable.

verification_material.description: Method-specific material needed for later verification.

system.description: External commitment system, such as a timestamp service, transparency log, or future Bitcoin commitment system.

external_identifier.description: Identifier assigned by the external commitment system.

proof_material.description: External proof material required for historical verification.

source_provenance.description: Structured provenance establishing the authoritative origin of the Source Artifact.

representation_provenance.description: Structured provenance describing representation selection, transformation, and canonicalization.

generation_provenance.description: Structured provenance describing integrity-generation processes and actors.

anchor_record_provenance.description: Optional provenance describing Anchor record construction, review, and preservation.

relationship_type.description: Relationship Type Controlled Value. Enumeration remains unfrozen.

target_system.description: System or institution governing the target identifier.

integrity_state.description: Integrity State Controlled Value. Enumeration remains unfrozen.

publication_state.description: Publication State Controlled Value. Enumeration remains unfrozen.

lifecycle_state.description: Lifecycle State Controlled Value. Enumeration remains unfrozen.

verification_identifier.description: Identifier of a separately governed Verification record if later architecture adopts one.

verification_result.description: Verification Result Controlled Value. Enumeration remains unfrozen.

correction_type.description: Correction Type Controlled Value if later adopted.
